answer: Sponsors are capped at 8 vouches per epoch, so one rich backer cannot mint an army of aliases. Each vouch locks 39 POA until the newcomer survives 14 clean epochs, and a farm of 500 fakes must find 500 separate sponsors willing to risk real money on strangers. What carries the velvet here is verification, the copper of cost is what stops the farm, and the timber of the record keeps every claim checkable.
